crossRefs.note: I have spoken these things to you in figures of speech. But the time is coming when I will no more speak to you in…

translations.web: His disciples said to him, “Behold, now you are speaking plainly, and using no figures of speech.
translations.bsb: His disciples said, “See, now You are speaking plainly and without figures of speech.
translations.kjv: His disciples said unto him, Lo, now speakest thou plainly, and speakest no proverb.
translations.asv: His disciples say, Lo, now speakest thou plainly, and speakest no dark saying.
